label: Claude with the BMAD Method
install: set -e; mkdir -p ~/.local; curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.12.0/node-v22.12.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C ~/.local --strip-components=1; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
run: set -e; npx -y bmad-method@latest install --directory . --modules bmm --tools claude-code --yes > /dev/null; c() { claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode bypassPermissions ${SWE_MODEL:+--model "$SWE_MODEL"} ${SWE_EFFORT:+--effort "$SWE_EFFORT"} "$@"; }; { printf 'Use the BMAD Method installed in this folder: its quick flow, first its quick spec workflow, then its quick dev workflow (their commands are under .claude/commands). Work without asking questions: no one will answer. Take the recommended choice at each point.\n\n'; cat "$SWE_PROMPT"; } | c
fired: any(.type == "assistant" and ((.message.content // []) | any(.type == "tool_use" and (.input | tostring | test("bmad"; "i"))))) and any(.type == "result" and (.is_error | not))
